I couldn't propose the 2 TB SSD order because I don't have an action tool in this session. No proposal was created and nothing was ordered. The data does show an urgent storage problem on this device, but that alone doesn't mean a bigger drive is the right fix.

**Evidence**
- 8NM23J95R5I6 is in acme-001. It is a ThinkPad X1 Carbon laptop (hostname acme-thinkpad-8), owned by emp-acme-1005 and running Windows 10 22H2 [8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12].
- It has a 1024 GB drive with 26.5 GB (2.6%) free. That is below the 10% low-disk threshold in the policy [disk_low/8NM23J95R5I6, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12].
- Free space dropped from 176.8 GB to 26.5 GB across 30 snapshots, about 5.2 GB a day. At that rate the disk is full in about 5 days [disk_trend/8NM23J95R5I6, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-05-14, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12].
- The installed software list shows nothing that explains the growth: Chrome, Slack, Zoom, 1Password and VS Code. None of these are on the policy's risky-software list [8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12].

**Recommendation**
- **Clean up first.** About 150 GB was used in a month, and a 2 TB drive would also fill up if that growth continues. Find out what is filling the disk (for example, caches, downloads, logs or local sync folders) and clear space before replacing the drive [disk_trend/8NM23J95R5I6].
- **Make sure the upgrade is the right one.** Before ordering, check whether this model's SSD can be replaced at all. The telemetry doesn't show this.
- **Weigh a full replacement.** The battery is marked "Service Recommended" after 1157 cycles, which is over the policy's rated 1000 cycles [8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12]. The device also fails `os_up_to_date` because it runs Windows 10 and the policy minimum is Windows 11. It fails `screen_lock` as well [8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12]. Taken together, replacing the whole laptop may make more sense than upgrading parts.

**Caveats**
- Your role is **viewer**. In a session with action tools, I could submit a proposal for someone with approval rights to review. As it stands, someone with the right permissions or the action tools needs to raise the order or the cleanup request. You can cite the findings above when they do.
